artworks.title: Mulier Danica
artworks.artist: Wenceslaus Hollar after Hendrik J. van Craenhals
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing upright. She has a calm expression and wears a cap covering her hair, with the front of her forehead visible. She is draped in a cloak that covers her body. The lower part of her dress is visible with pleats at the hem. She wears flat shoes and the background is plain. Inscriptions on the image read "a Danish Woman" and "Mulier Danica," alongside details of the artist.

artworks.title: Nobilis Mulier Gallica
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing in profile, facing left. She is upright with one hand extended to her side and the other holding a closed fan by her hip. She has distinct facial features, styled hair, and is wearing a gown with a floral pattern and striped bodice, a cape, lacework, a necklace, and a chain with small items at her waist. The background is a plain textured surface.

artworks.title: Mulier Generosa Gallica
artworks.description: This is an image of a woman standing. She faces forward and gazes slightly to the left. She has an oval face and curly hair that cascades onto her shoulders. She wears a long, flowing dress with intricate patterns, lace details, and puffed sleeves. She holds a folding fan in her right hand and gathers her dress with her left hand. She wears a choker necklace. The background is plain with a small inscription at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Mulier Nobilis aut Generosa Gallica
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a woman shown in full length. She is standing in a three-quarter profile, facing slightly to the left. Her facial features include a delicate, composed expression with eyes gazing forward and a slightly elongated face. Her hair is styled in loose waves, cascading down past her shoulders. She is dressed in an elegant gown with intricate patterns on the skirt and a full, dark, flowing cloak over her shoulder. The bodice is adorned with lace detailing and has short sleeves with similar lace trim. In her hands, she holds a closed fan delicately. She appears to wear no visible jewelry. The background of the image is plain, with no discernible details, placing full emphasis on the figure.

artworks.title: Rustica Gallica
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing in profile, facing right. She has softly detailed facial features, long hair tied back, and wears a historical outfit with a long-sleeved gown, apron, and bonnet. She holds a basket at her waist.

artworks.title: Matrona Parisiensis
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing in a poised manner. Her body is entirely visible, displaying her attire. She faces slightly to the right, with her hands clasped in front of her, covered by a cloak. Her facial features include round cheeks and a straight nose, with hair styled in a bob cut with a middle parting, reaching her shoulders. She wears a layered outfit consisting of a skirt, a cloak with wide sleeves, and a collar draping over her shoulders. The clothing appears to be rich in fabric with a textured design. The background is plain, emphasizing the woman and her attire. The figure lacks visible jewelry or objects, drawing attention to her facial expression and clothing. Below the woman is the inscription "Matrona Parisiensis," and additional artist's details are in the lower right corner.

artworks.title: Mercatoris Parisiensis Vxor
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman standing upright. She is wearing a long dress with a fitted bodice, puffed sleeves, and a large collar. She is holding a book in her right hand and her left hand rests on her skirt. Her features include a long, thin nose, pronounced chin, and eyes looking directly at the viewer. Her hair is styled in a short bob. She wears pointed shoes and there is no visible jewelry. The background is plain. The text at the bottom reads "Mercatoris Parisiensis Uxor" and the artist's signature "W. Hollar fecit, 1643" is visible.

artworks.title: Opificis Parisiensis Vxor
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing with her arms crossed at her midriff. She has short, bobbed hair, a structured face with a straight nose and lips, and is wearing a dress with a long apron. In her left hand, she holds a small bundle or tools. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Mulier Diepana
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman standing with her body slightly angled to the side. She has delicate facial features, narrow eyes, and a slight smile. Her hair is neatly pulled back. She is wearing a voluminous cloak with a textured collar, over a long pleated skirt that reaches the ground. Her hands are clasped in front of her, partially hidden by the cloak. There are no visible accessories or objects. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Mulier Diepana
artworks.description: The image shows a person in profile, facing right, with hands clasped below shoulder level. The individual's face is obscured by a voluminous, textured hairstyle. They wear a long skirt with vertical stripes, a long-sleeved top, and a shawl draped over their shoulders. The background is plain, and the style is monochromatic, resembling an engraving.

artworks.title: Mulier Generosa Italica
artworks.description: The image features a woman in full profile from head to toe, standing and facing right. Her head is turned slightly forward, showing her side profile. She has a delicately defined face with styled hair pulled back and adorned with curls, wearing a wide-brimmed hat with a plume. She is dressed in an elaborate gown with textured and patterned fabric, a high lace collar, fitted sleeves, and intricate embroidery, holding a fan. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Mulier Calabra, Vulgo, Foretana di Napoli
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing, facing forward with hands extended in front. She has curly hair, a headdress, and wears a dress with a layered skirt. She also wears a necklace and a shawl. The background is plain and there is text framing the image.

artworks.title: Mulier Nobilis Hispanica (Spanish Noblewoman)
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman standing in profile, facing left. She has an elaborate updo with a decorative accessory, wearing a long gown with embroidered details and a wide collar. She holds a fluffy fan or adornment in her right hand. The background is plain, and there are inscriptions above and below her in a finely detailed monochrome engraving.

artworks.title: Mulier Generosa Hispanica (Spanish Gentlewoman)
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing upright with her hands clasped at her waist. She has finely detailed facial features and dark, rounded hair styled with an elaborate headpiece adorned with a feather. She is wearing a detailed gown with a wide collar, wide sleeves, and an ornate bodice that extends down to her feet. The background of the image has a faint texture, with text labeling her as "a Spanish Gentle woman" and "Mulier Generosa Hispanica."

artworks.title: Matrisana M.
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing with their feet slightly apart, facing away. They are wearing a hooded garment that covers their head and shoulders. The person is also wearing a long-sleeved top, a long skirt with vertical striped patterns, and is barefoot. The background has a plain surface with visible sketch marks and text above and below the figure detailing the title and artist.

artworks.title: Mulier Matrisana
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing upright in full-length profile view. She is facing right with her hands folded in front of her torso. She has a distinct nose and closed lips. She wears a headscarf covering her hair, which is tied at the back and draped over her shoulders. Her outfit includes a patterned dress with horizontal stripes on the sleeves and a vertically striped apron-like garment with intricate geometric designs. She also wears long skirts and plain shoes. The background has a textured surface with faded writing at the top and bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Nobilis Mulier Aulica Anglicana
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman in a full-length portrait standing in profile, turned slightly to her left. She has tightly curled hair, a high forehead, and is wearing an elaborate gown with lace trim on the collar and cuffs. She is holding a folded fan at her waistline and wearing a pearl necklace. The background is plain with text inscriptions including "Lady of the Court of England" and "Nobilis Mulier Aulica Anglicana."

artworks.title: Nobilis Mulier Anglica
artworks.artist: Wenceslaus Hollar after Sir Anthony van Dyck
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a woman in full-body profile facing right. She is holding a fan in her right hand at waist level. Her hair is styled elegantly with an elaborate bun, curls framing her face. She has delicate facial features with a serene expression. She wears an ornate gown with lace detail on the bodice and sleeves, and a flowing skirt. She also wears a choker or lace collar. The background is plain, with the inscription "Nobilis Mulier Anglica," the artist's details, and the year 1644 at the top.

artworks.title: Nobilis Mulier Anglica, in Vestitu Hiemali
artworks.description: The image shows a person facing to the right, wearing historical ornate attire, including a voluminous dress with a fur-trimmed cape and a head covering that conceals the lower part of the face. The clothing appears to be made of heavy and luxurious fabrics. The hand is not visible. The background is plain, and text below the figure reads "Nobilis Mulier Anglica."

artworks.title: Nobilis Mulier Anglicana
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body illustration of an English noblewoman. She is standing upright, slightly turned towards her left, with her left arm extended in front of her. The woman's facial features include a slightly rounded face, a small chin, and an expressionless gaze towards the viewer. Her hair is curly and shoulder-length, with ringlets framing her face. She wears an intricate gown with a high collar, puffed sleeves, and lace details. She holds a small purse in her left hand that hangs down at her side. The background is plain. The engraving features detailed lines capturing the texture of her clothing and hair. The text "Nobilis Mulier Anglicana" at the bottom of the image identifies her as an English noblewoman.

artworks.title: Mulier Nobilis aut Generosa Anglica
artworks.description: The image shows the full body of a woman standing in profile facing left. She has delicate facial features with a slightly pointed nose and her hair is styled in an updo with some curls falling down her neck. She wears a long, layered gown with puffed sleeves, wide cuffs, and a wide collar draping over her shoulders. The skirt is gathered at the back into a bustle. She is holding a decorative fan in her left hand. There are no visible jewelry or additional objects. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Mulier Generosa Anglica
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing upright with a solemn expression. She has narrow eyes, a pointed nose, and wears a bonnet covering her hair. She is dressed in period-specific attire including a long gown, a shawl, and gloves. She holds a small object in her left hand by her side. The background is plain, emphasizing the woman. The text above and below the figure identifies her as an "English Gentlewoman" with "Mulier Generosa Anglica" at the bottom.

artworks.title: Mulier Generosa Anglica
artworks.description: The image shows a woman in profile, facing right. She is wearing a long gown with a shawl, holding a fur muff in front of her. The background is plain with two handwritten captions - "English Gentle woman" at the top left and "Mulier Generosa Anglica" at the bottom.

artworks.title: Mulier Generosa Anglica
artworks.description: The image is an illustration of a woman standing. She has a composed expression, visible eyebrows and is looking ahead. Her hair is styled in an updo with curls falling around her face. She wears a long-sleeved dress with a fitted bodice, square neckline, full skirt, and sash at the waist. One hand holds part of the fabric. The background is plain. Writing in the top right corner reads "Ein Englische vom Adel 164" and "Mulier Generosa Anglica" is at the bottom of the illustration.
